# Sawians
Sawians are a group of artificially created species based off of various earth genomes, often manning Nanotrasen stations. Sawians are biologically genderless, though some still sport masculine/feminine features visually. They are not accustomed to wearing clothes. The less they're wearing the faster they move.
#Health Sawians are remarkably durable, made to live in conditions deadly to most species - Most are given brain implants allowing them an advance readout of their bodies condition. - Their extremely fast metabolism makes them great at healing most wounds, though it comes at the cost of highly increased hunger.
#Conformity - Any deviation in personality or genetic composition within a species is a rarity - differences are likely from personal trinkets, scars, or accessories. - For management purposes all Sawians are given a unique Identification number and are allowed one nickname. (e.g., [color=yellow]#4466 John[/color], [color=yellow]#7201 Jimmy[/color], [color=yellow]#1793 Jane[/color]) All Sawians employed under Nanotrasen are expected to use their provided number in place of a name while filling paperwork.
